description: This file defines an API for managing a dynamic array of object identifiers (`struct object_id`). It provides functions for appending, looking up, sorting, filtering, and iterating over object IDs, emphasizing efficiency for large lists. It includes functions to handle unique elements and to sort the collection, and defines a struct to hold the array state.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the array, possibly reallocating memory.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs binary search to find an object ID in the sorted array; sorts if not sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees memory used by the array and resets it to an empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID, calling the provided callback.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in sorted order, calling the callback.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Filters the array in place, keeping only object IDs for which the callback returns true.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array of object IDs in ascending order.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after the given position; requires sorted array.

search-terms: C header array of object IDs

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
